title: The Doppelganger
text: At dawn there is one Scion too many in camp. Two of them sit by the fire, the same face, the same scars, the same way of holding a cup. Both of them swear they are the real one. Both of them are frightened, or both of them are very good at it.

options.label: The sharpest asks what only the real one would know.

outcomes.text: The false one fumbles a childhood name, and its face slips, and it runs.
Both answer perfectly. Both of them smile.

options.label: Keep both until one gives itself away.

outcomes.text: It gives itself away at the worst possible moment, with a knife.
Silver burns one of them, and it stops pretending.
